spec.concept: Credibility through a track record of completed smart contract audits, with an invitation to request a review
spec.scene: A clean brand card with a deep navy background, a simple amber shield outline at the center, and a thin white line grid suggesting structured code, leaving space for the overlay text
spec.alt_text: Navy brand card with an amber shield outline and the text: completed 12 smart contract audits

spec.concept: Reentrancy risk: external calls made before state is finalized, fixed by ordering updates ahead of interactions
spec.scene: Technical card on a deep navy background. A simple diagram shows a contract box with an arrow going out to a second box and a return arrow looping back into the first box, with a small amber marker on the loop. Plenty of empty space for the overlay text, in a calm and precise style.
spec.alt_text: Diagram of one contract calling another, with an arrow looping back into the first contract to show a reentrant callback, on a navy background with amber accents.

spec.concept: Access control on Ether withdrawals: only authorized callers should be able to move funds out of a contract
spec.scene: A dark navy card with a simple vault outline in amber, its door ajar, and a single amber key line pointing to the lock. Clean flat geometric style with generous empty space for the overlay text.
spec.alt_text: Navy brand card with an amber vault outline and key, with the text: Limit withdrawals to authorized parties

spec.concept: Price oracle manipulation as a broken trust boundary between a contract and the market price it reads
spec.scene: Technical style card on a deep navy background: a simple line diagram of a price feed passing through a gate into a contract block, with the gate drawn as a thin amber outline and one amber bar spiking out of a small pool shape to suggest a moved price. Plenty of empty space for the overlay text, calm and precise, no extra text in the artwork.
spec.overlay_text: An oracle is a trust boundary
spec.alt_text: Navy technical card with an amber line diagram of a price feed passing through a gate into a contract, with the text: An oracle is a trust boundary

spec.concept: Authorization through tx.origin: the original sender is not the immediate caller, so checks should use msg.sender
spec.scene: Dark navy background with a simple call chain diagram: an owner node connects to an attack wallet node, which connects to a victim wallet node. An amber highlight marks the owner label that still persists at the end of the chain, with a white check line contrasted by a blocked amber line labeled msg.sender. Clean, minimal, technical layout with generous space for overlay text.
spec.alt_text: Diagram of a call chain from an owner to an attack wallet to a victim wallet, showing that tx.origin still points at the owner while msg.sender shows the immediate caller.
